magic_signatures.description: Save magic u32 0xC0DE608D at record base; validated by FUN_0801f7a4 against DAT_0801f7b4 and written by FUN_0801f818 from DAT_0801f86c.

fields.name: completion_flag
fields.description: Validity/completion flag tested == 0xBA by FUN_0801f6c0 and applied to game state by FUN_0801f870; baseline 0xFF means unset.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801f6c0 returns *(char *)(param_1 + 4) == -0x46 (0xBA); FUN_0801f870 passes it to FUN_0800ba78.

fields.name: config_byte
fields.description: Config byte saved from ROM default DAT_0801f814 by FUN_0801f80c and restored to DAT_0801f808 by FUN_0801f800.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801f80c writes *(char *)(param_1 + 5) from DAT_0801f814; FUN_0801f800 stores save+5 into DAT_0801f808; both called from FUN_0801f818 / FUN_0801f870.

fields.name: game_option_a
fields.description: Game option byte mirrored from game state via FUN_0800ba54 getter on save and FUN_0800ba48 setter on load.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801f818 stores FUN_0800ba54(param_2) into save+6; FUN_0801f870 restores it via FUN_0800ba48.

fields.name: audio_level_a
fields.description: First audio level, stored as hardware level >> 4 and applied as value << 4.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801f7dc stores FUN_08021cac() >> 4 into save+7; FUN_0801f7c4 applies save+7 << 4 via FUN_08021d6c.

fields.name: audio_level_b
fields.description: Second audio level, stored as hardware level >> 4 and applied as value << 4.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801f7dc stores FUN_08021ca0() >> 4 into save+8; FUN_0801f7c4 applies save+8 << 4 via FUN_08021da0.

fields.name: record_id_0
fields.description: ID table slot 0, persisted low half of game-state word at +0x18c; table is searched by FUN_0800c3c4 for IDs 1, 2, 0x100, 0x200 in FUN_0800f6ec.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801f818 copies *(u32 *)(game + 0x18c) truncated to save+10; FUN_0801f870 restores via FUN_0800c3b4(idx 0); FUN_08003bb4 feeds race-result words into the same table.

fields.name: record_id_1
fields.description: ID table slot 1, persisted low half of game-state word at +0x190.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801f818 copies *(u32 *)(game + 400) truncated to save+12; FUN_0801f870 restores via FUN_0800c3b4(idx 1).

fields.name: record_id_2
fields.description: ID table slot 2, persisted low half of game-state word at +0x194.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801f818 copies *(u32 *)(game + 0x194) truncated to save+14; FUN_0801f870 restores via FUN_0800c3b4(idx 2).

fields.name: record_id_3
fields.description: ID table slot 3, persisted low half of game-state word at +0x198.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801f818 copies *(u32 *)(game + 0x198) truncated to save+16; FUN_0801f870 restores via FUN_0800c3b4(idx 3).

fields.name: boot_counter
fields.description: Boot/write-cycle counter incremented mod 32 on every boot in FUN_08029818.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801f7a0 reads save+0x12; FUN_0801f79c writes it; FUN_08029818 computes (iVar1 + 1) mod 0x20 and commits via FUN_08011efc.

fields.name: game_option_b
fields.description: Game option byte mirrored from game state via FUN_0800ba6c getter on save and FUN_0800ba60 setter on load; new-game path FUN_0800c584 initializes it to 1.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801f818 stores FUN_0800ba6c(param_2) into save+0x13; FUN_0801f870 restores via FUN_0800ba60; FUN_0800c584 calls FUN_0800ba60(...,1).
